description: Every renderer-path paired sample, raw and timestamp-free. Aggregates in summary.md are derived views only.

m1-center-out-pure-order.note: Pure center-out dispatch order (all waves) measured before the shipped hybrid order (center-out first wave, row-ordered remainder). Retained as raw data: the paired run showed the pure order deferring expensive periphery bands behind the queue on mi-hard-rabbit-boundary (+918 ms median, beyond the max(5%, 20 ms) cap), which motivated the hybrid.
